description: Run TakeMeUp's free ATS (applicant tracking system) check on one of the user's CVs: a 0–100 score and specific findings such as weak verbs, missing dates, unquantified bullets and formatting problems. No AI, no cost. Use when the user asks whether their CV or resume is ATS-friendly or will pass automated screening.

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: analyze_takemeup_cv_ats
title: ATS check (free)
